configuration: IM/CIMI configured with ./Config.pl -EarthHO -GridDefault and built with make CIMI; the upstream test_rundir_drift run directory with input/testfiles/PARAM.in.test.drift as PARAM.in: 100 s of 22 July 2009 saving the drift velocity of all three species, on 2 MPI ranks
observable: the bounce-averaged drift velocities of H+, O+ and electrons across the CIMI grid over the saved frames
default_vs_upstream: upstream, except that the IM/CIMI input files that the upstream run directory copies out of the separate SWMF_data repository travel with the check under ic/<name>/imdata/, because code/swmf vendors only the GM and SC part of SWMF_data; only the files this deck reads are carried, so IndicesKpApF107.dat and the wave-diffusion tables the deck does not open are absent and the upstream run-directory recipe's copy of them is a no-op; the run, the Config.pl configuration, the deck and the graded files are the upstream test's
variant: ic/variant differs from ic/nominal in one number: the first flux value of the quiet-time H+ initial distribution table (energy channel 1 at the innermost L shell), 1.26e+08 in ic/nominal and 1.260000002e+08 in ic/variant. It is generic numerical-noise calibration, two units of the tenth significant digit of one active initial-condition input; the two runs' spread is the floor this pass policy can be held to, not the tolerance itself.
altbuild: the same Config.pl configuration built with ./Config.pl -O0 before make CIMI, which sets every OPTn level of Makefile.conf to -O0 where the shipped gfortran template uses -O3; same pinned source, same deck

evidence.floor_how: measured by selfcheck: run.sh altbuild (the -O0 build described in the altbuild line) against run.sh nominal, graded with this check's own validate.py

warrant: The graded observable is the bounce-averaged drift velocities of H+, O+ and electrons across the CIMI grid over the saved frames, compared value by value under |candidate - reference| <= 1e-10 + 0.001*|reference|. Physical: the bounce-averaged drift solve advects the phase-space density through the L, MLT, energy and pitch-angle grid every IM step (IM/CIMI/src/ModCimi.f90 driftIM with the ELSR advection of IM/CIMI/src/ModDrift.f90), the field-line integration sets the flux-tube volume, the equatorial field and the bounce-averaged coefficients (IM/CIMI/src/ModFieldTrace.f90 fieldpara), and the loss terms - charge exchange against the geocorona, the loss cone, strong or wave-driven pitch-angle and energy diffusion (IM/CIMI/src/ModWaveDiff.f90) and the decay term - each remove a definite fraction of the distribution per step; a drift velocity built from the wrong potential or field gradient, a dropped loss term, a diffusion coefficient interpolated on the wrong grid, or an advection scheme that loses its monotonic limiter moves these numbers in their first or second significant digit well inside the hundred seconds the deck runs, orders of magnitude above a relative 1e-3; the bound this check applies to every graded value is the one the upstream IM/CIMI check applies to the same files, share/Scripts/DiffNum.pl -r=0.001 -a=1e-10 in IM/CIMI/Makefile. The step number, the simulated time, the grid dimensions, the variable names and every other number and word around the data are graded too, so a port that stops at a different step, saves a different number of frames or writes a different grid fails on shape rather than on tolerance. Achievable: FLOOR_SENTENCE
